title: Run the game once, unchanged
body:
Make sure your copy builds and passes its quick tests:

```sh
npm ci && node tools/kit.mjs check
```

Want Claude to do it? Comment `@claude please do this task` on this issue.

title: Start the LAVA TAG minigame
check: npm run build && node --test test/mg-lavatag.test.mjs test/party.test.mjs
body:
This writes a new minigame that already plays and adds it to Party:

```sh
node tools/new-mg.mjs lavatag lg "LAVA TAG"
```

Check:

```sh
npm run build && node --test test/mg-lavatag.test.mjs test/party.test.mjs
```

Want Claude to do it? Comment `@claude please do this task` on this issue.

title: One player is it, and a tag passes it on
body:
Pick who starts as "it". Bumping another player makes them "it".

Check:

```sh
npm run build && node --test test/mg-lavatag.test.mjs
```

Want Claude to do it? Comment `@claude please do this task` on this issue.

title: A lava trail behind whoever is it
body:
The floor turns to lava where "it" rolls, for a few seconds. Touch it and you're out.

Check:

```sh
npm run build && node --test test/mg-lavatag.test.mjs
```

title: Bots that chase and dodge
body:
Teach the AI players the rules: chase when they're it, dodge the lava when they're not.

Check:

```sh
node --test test/mg-lavatag.test.mjs
```

title: See it on your page
body:
Turn on your page once: Settings > Pages > Source: GitHub Actions. Then `client/party.html?mg=30` on it plays LAVA TAG.

```sh
npm run build && node tools/site.mjs
```
